Absolutely Stunning Wedding Photos – Thank You, UR FUN PHOTOGRAPHERR!

I can’t stop smiling while going through all the incredible photos from my brother’s wedding—thanks to UR FUN PHOTOGRAPHERR! From the Haldi to the Reception, Rahul Gor and his team captured every laugh, tear, and dance move so perfectly that it feels like we’re reliving the best moments all over again.

What I loved most was how natural and fun they made everything. No stiff poses or forced smiles—just pure, joyful moments frozen in time. They blended into the crowd yet somehow managed to catch all the little details we would’ve missed. The candid shots? Chef’s kiss! And the way they played with lighting and angles in the portraits? Absolutely magical.

A massive shoutout to Rahul and his team for being so patient, creative, and full of positive energy throughout all the events. You didn’t just take photos—you gave us memories we’ll treasure forever.

If you want a photographer who’s talented, easygoing, and genuinely passionate about their work, UR FUN PHOTOGRAPHERR is the one. 10/10, would recommend to everyone!

Thanks again for making our wedding celebrations even more special. You guys rock!

With love,
Harish Kharvi

Rahul and the entire UR FUN team, hats off to you. You gave us more than just pictures and videos — you gave us the feeling of those moments all over again. Your team is super professional, insanely talented, and above all, you truly care. That shows in every detail.

This isn’t just a recommendation — it’s a shoutout from the heart. If you’re planning any event, trust these guys blindly. They’ll not only capture your moments, they’ll turn them into timeless memories.

Thank you, thank you, thank you — for being part of the most important days of our lives, and for doing it with so much fun, energy, and love. You guys are unreal!

featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired this photographer for two preschool events with a fixed rate agreed for both events.
On the morning of the first event, he suddenly demanded ₹500 extra for just 15 additional minutes, which was never discussed during finalization.
The quality of work was extremely poor:
Main events were missed, while irrelevant side moments were covered
Videos were blurry
No noise cancellation during speeches and parent testimonials
Overall output was unusable and disappointing
When we shared our feedback, he initially accepted his mistake. We requested to meet before the second event to clearly guide him on what needed coverage. After this, he stopped answering calls and messages.
As the second event date approached, he:
Increased the price to double the committed amount
Refused to meet or discuss
Claimed he was traveling
Asked for advance payment
Said he would only talk 2 days before the event
To cover up his poor work, he started blaming us for mismanagement, which was completely untrue.
Additional concerns:
Very poor song selection in videos
If changes are requested, he claims he is “too busy” to discuss
No studio address provided; asked us to meet on a roadside while taking advance
Claimed to bring an extra photographer, but that person was clearly inexperienced and delivered badly zoomed, awkward photos that looked like low-quality BTS shots
Overall, this was a highly unprofessional and dishonest experience.
Not recommended at all, especially for important events involving children and parents.

featured_reviews.name: Mihir Karoor
featured_reviews.review_text:
Parag couldn’t have been more professional or friendly from the moment we made contact with him. Having heard of his work before we were so excited to see what he had in store for us. He went beyond the “standard photographer requirements”, helping us plan timings and giving tips to get the best shots, thus keeping us much stress relieved. Parag ensured capturing all the guests in the shutter box along with proper spacing to include enough candid moments of the bride and the groom. He used his art and designing skills to make all our memories tangible for us, through a finesse photo album, all in a pocket-friendly price.
From start to finish, the level of detail Parag showed to capture creative and unique shots was amazing. My wife and I were apprehensive about our wedding photos and how they'd turn out as we are both not the most comfortable ones in front of a camera, until we met Parag. He made us comfortable and captured the pictures skillfully. He caught a perfect blend of candid, staged and funny moments, thus capturing pictures above our imagination.In addition to capturing pictures, delivering the album was also like in a jiffy. We are amazed with the perfection in his work. The passion and love for his work can be seen through the incredible album we get to keep forever!
Words fall less to explain how awesome Parag is, he is just the ultimate photographer out there, and you will not regret hiring him. Anybody who meets Parag can clearly see his true passion for his work and this reflects in his genuine desire to give you the most amazing and unique memories. 5 on 5 is too less for the amazing dedication with which Parag works. If you are looking for someone who you can blindly trust with capturing the best of your wedding day, its him. We would 100% recommend getting a photo album done through Parag.
Parag, the work you did for our wedding was just wonderful!!! We cannot thank you enough for all your time and effort into making our special day, one to remember for the rest of our lives.Thank you so much Parag. You are amazing! With enough amazing shots it was difficult for us to choose the favorites for the album :)
